keyword: can you watch the oscars on disney plus

verifications.claim: In the U.S., the Oscars cannot be watched live directly on Disney+.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'Will the Oscars be on Disney+? No. ... to stream the Academy Awards live on Hulu, you need to be signed into your bundle account via Hulu (not Disney+).'; R2: 'the Academy Awards will only stream live on Hulu. If you're a bundle subscriber ... activate your Hulu account via Disney+ first to log in to Hulu's platform.'; R4: 'people who have HULU in their Disney+ plus bundle won’t have a live stream?? ... use her Disney+ login in the Hulu app.'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly state live streaming is on Hulu, not directly on Disney+, even for bundle subscribers who must access via Hulu app.
